# The two-dimensional atmosphere solver {#sec-ch09}

This chapter describes the Python solver of `python/atm2d`, which advances the composition of an atmosphere on a
two-dimensional grid of columns. It holds the state, computes transport by eddy and molecular diffusion, takes
chemistry as caller-supplied source terms (kintera's kinetics and photochemistry modules of @sec-ch06 and @sec-ch07
contribute Jacobian blocks only), assembles the implicit operator as one sparse system, and advances it with a
Rosenbrock step of adaptive size or solves for a steady state with Newton's method. The step drivers transport
vertically only; horizontal mixing and boundary rows are available in the operator builders. The
linear algebra it relies on is described in @sec-ch10.

| scheme | YAML key or option | default | order | main test |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| @sec-ch09-state | `AtmState2D`, `CoreConfig` (API) | caller | n/a | `test_atm2d.py` |
| @sec-ch09-transport | `form` | `mr_diffusion` with a density | second in space (not measured) | `test_atm2d.py` |
| @sec-ch09-molecular | `binary_diffusion`, `mr_exp`, `mr_hybrid` | off | hydrostatic profile exact in mr forms (run) | run `[R8]` |
| @sec-ch09-sources | `sources` (API) | caller | n/a | `test_atm2d.py` |
| @sec-ch09-assembly | `assembly` (API) | always | n/a | `test_atm2d.py` |
| @sec-ch09-rosenbrock | `rosenbrock2_step`, `adaptive_advance` (API) | caller | second in time (run) | `test_adaptive_timestep.py` |
| @sec-ch09-newton | `KINTERA_CHEM_SOLVER` | `newton` | first in time | `test_atm2d.py` |
| @sec-ch09-conservation | `project_atomic_budget`, pins (API) | caller | n/a | `test_refactor_phase1.py` |
